data.title: 户隐憧子 · 烛光寝室的真丝晨袍独语
data.description: 温暖烛火摇曳的静谧寝室，深色丝绒床单上散落着翻开的书页。憧子身穿深紫色的长款真丝睡袍，腰带松垮地挽在腰际，胸前若隐若现露出优雅迷人的锁骨线条。平日在学院里雷厉风行的前辈，此刻端着酒杯静静坐在床边，微醺的眼眸深邃而含蓄，透着成熟女性无尽的魅力。
data.location: sophisticated modern master bedroom with warm candlelight and velvet accents
data.action: sitting on edge of plush bed holding wine glass in candlelight, silk robe draped loosely revealing collarbone, alluring mature gaze
data.lighting: intimate amber candle flames reflecting off dark silk fabric and crystal glass
data.mood: refined mature seduction, quiet intoxicating sanctuary
data.promptProse: Seated upon the edge of a velvet bed in warm candlelight, Touko Togakushi holds a delicate crystal glass. Her deep purple silk robe drapes loosely over bare collarbones as she looks forward with alluring, mature tenderness.
data.animaCaption: Touko sitting on a candlelit bed in a silk robe holding a glass of wine with an alluring gaze.
